# modebox

> Code mode for AI agents, sandboxed. modebox runs the JavaScript or TypeScript an agent writes in a WebAssembly sandbox (QuickJS on wasmtime) whose only authority is the functions you hand it. When a call needs approval, the run is sealed into an encrypted token and resumes later, even in another process, without re-running anything. It works as an MCP server for any agent, or as a library from Node, Python and Rust. macOS and Linux; Windows isn't supported.

Install: `cargo install modebox` (the CLI and MCP server), `npm install modebox` (Node API), `pip install modebox` (Python API).

## Docs
